run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum difference between max and min in K-size subsets of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct minimum difference calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and finds the smallest range among all K-element windows
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that uses sorting and sliding window to minimize max-min difference in subsets
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by sorting a copy instead
